A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

Research summary for /tank/dev-worktrees/bm-ops (read-only; nothing run or modified).

**Short answer**
- No customer-facing discount mechanism touches a dedicated order, IP order or invoice at checkout.
- Four other things can reach it:
  - Wallet balance built from promo credit can pay for it. The wallet has no cash/promo separation.
  - Admin-controlled pricing (setup waiver, price override, negative markup, custom offers) can lower it.
  - A partner commission can accrue on it.
  - A referral reward can be triggered by its card leg.
- Refunds: only the extra-IP "Reject & refund" and the generic admin invoice refund can target dedicated money. There is no self-serve or automatic refund for a dedicated server.
- Disputes: only recorded and alerted, nothing automatic.
- Note: "dedicatedIp" elsewhere in the repo (lib/dedicated-ip.ts, lib/dedicated-ip-purchase.ts, `reconcileFailedDedicatedIp`) is the VPS dedicated-IPv4 add-on, not bare metal. Bare metal uses `DedicatedIpOrder` / `placeDedicatedIpOrder`.

**0. Dedicated payment path, as built**
- `quoteDedicatedOrder` (lib/dedicated/order.ts:~411) computes price = `sellFor` (catalogue cost, markup, rounding, uplift) + setup + tax. It calls `orderMoney` (lib/dedicated/order-core.ts:~92). A 12-month term is monthly x 12 with no discount (order-core.ts:26-30 says so explicitly).
- It never calls the coupon, partner, promo, intro or annual-discount code.
- `payDedicatedOrder` (lib/actions-dedicated-order.ts:~70-100) uses `walletSplit` (balance first, then card for the remainder).
- `createDedicatedOrderPaymentSession` (lib/stripe.ts:847) and `createDedicatedIpOrderPaymentSession` (lib/stripe.ts:884) pass no `discounts` and no `allow_promotion_codes`. The only inputs are a fixed `unit_amount` and metadata.
  - There are no Stripe coupon or promotion-code calls anywhere in the repo.
  - The only `allow_promotion_codes` mention is a comment at app/api/stripe/checkout/route.ts:37, explaining why it is not used for top-ups.
  - Top-ups also refuse a stale coupon cookie (route.ts:~42-55).
- No partner or creator cookie is read at session creation. `nxeon_ref` is consumed at signup only (lib/actions.ts:76, Google and Discord OAuth callbacks). `nx_partner_ref` (lib/partner.ts:137) becomes `partnerSource` on VPS orders only (lib/stripe.ts:614,1508,1699).
- Fulfilment (lib/fulfil-checkout.ts):
  - Shared preamble: `creditCheckoutSession` (lib/stripe.ts:1841) credits the card leg to the wallet. For dedicated sessions `isPurchaseLegSession` (stripe.ts:1814) is true, so there is no top-up invoice.
  - It then calls `maybeRewardReferral(userId)` (stripe.ts:1926-1930).
  - Branches: `dedicatedOrder` at fulfil-checkout.ts:756-780 calls `placeDedicatedOrder` with the stamped price. `dedicatedIpOrder` at :785-807 calls `placeDedicatedIpOrder`.
  - The preamble applies no partner discount and no coupon.
- `placeDedicatedOrder` (order.ts:~494-610):
  - `assertSpendCap`, `debitWallet`, a wallet ledger row, then a PAID invoice (description "Bare Metal Dedicated Server — …"), then a `DedicatedServer` row (PENDING).
  - The stamped `money` is the price, with no discount line.
- `placeDedicatedIpOrder` (lib/dedicated/ip-order.ts:~55-100): `debitWallet`, then a PAID invoice, then a `DedicatedIpOrder` (PAID) that waits for admin approval.
- Dedicated renewals are manual. `DedicatedServer.renewalDate` and `renewalMonthlyCents` are only set by `placeDedicatedOrder`, by the admin form (lib/actions-dedicated.ts:~189-215), and by IP jobs (worker/dedicated-jobs.ts:121).
  - worker/billing.ts and worker/product-renewals.ts never touch `DedicatedServer`.
  - So renewal-time discounts (partner 10% recurring, retention offer, grandfathered price, annual discount, `renewalCharge`) cannot reach dedicated.
  - The offer-fulfil.ts:453 task text says renewals are invoiced by hand.

**1. Discount mechanisms (all reach dedicated: NO unless noted)**
- Coupon engine: `Coupon` model (prisma/schema.prisma:1909; kinds at :1882; scopes at :1896).
  - Math is `couponOrderDiscountCents` (lib/coupon-order.ts:83). Its `serviceKind` is only ANY, VPS or GAME.
  - Claims: `claimOrderCoupon` (lib/order.ts:613), `orderCouponClaimable` (:673), `reserveOrderCoupon` (lib/coupon-redemption.ts:223).
  - Applied in lib/order.ts (~:467) and lib/game-order.ts only. Not dedicated.
  - The `CREDIT_CENTS` kind grants wallet credit instead. See section 2.
- Seeded and named codes:
  - NXSAVE40 (lib/flash-sale.ts:30)
  - TRIAL798 (lib/promo-trial.ts:33)
  - COMEBACK50 (worker/deploy-winback.ts:35)
  - WEMISSYOU30 (worker/dormant-winback.ts:28)
  - SEA price-test coupon (lib/sea-price-test.ts, default off)
  - All are ordinary coupons, so VPS or game only. Not dedicated.
- First month free: lib/promotions.ts and lib/promo-redemption.ts:157 (`FIRST_MONTH_FREE_SERVICES = ["HOSTING"]`, `claimFirstMonthFree` at :234). Shared web hosting only. Not dedicated.
- Intro pricing: `introFirstTermDiscountCents` (lib/intro-pricing.ts:71), used in lib/order.ts:388, lib/game-order.ts:48 and lib/actions-custom-plan.ts. VPS, game and custom plan only. Not dedicated.
- Annual and term discount: `termDiscountPct` (lib/billing-terms.ts:56), `annualDiscountPct()` (lib/annual-discount.ts:26). The default is 20 (billing-terms.ts:~24-30), though annual-discount.ts's comment says 10. Used by VPS, hosting, nxcloud and renewals. Dedicated 12-month is undiscounted.
- Partner and creator program (lib/partner-discount.ts:18,20; lib/partner-pricing.ts:37,58,128): 50% off the first purchase, then 10% on everything after, including renewals, with domains excluded.
  - Applied in lib/order.ts, lib/game-order.ts, lib/actions-hosting.ts:~307-360, lib/actions-email-hosting.ts:~422-458 and renewal-charge.ts:301 (worker/billing.ts:302,408,745). Not dedicated.
  - A creator code can be attached from the deploy wizard (lib/actions-creator-code.ts `applyCreatorCode`, lib/creator-code.ts). That only attaches the customer to the partner.
- Partner commission: this is a cost to Nxeon, not a customer price cut. It does reach dedicated.
  - `accrueCommissionForInvoice` (lib/partner-commission.ts:94) accrues on ANY PAID invoice with a positive amount that isn't a wallet top-up (`isCommissionableInvoice` at :52-57). There is no dedicated exclusion. Only the VPS dedicated-IP slice (`dedicatedIpCents`) is excluded.
  - The sweep `reconcilePartnerCommissions` (:194, called from worker/index.ts:3339) picks up dedicated order and IP invoices for any partner-attached customer.
  - The inline `accrueRecentCommissionsForCustomer` hooks are in order.ts, game-order.ts, actions-hosting.ts, actions-email-hosting.ts and actions.ts. None are in the dedicated files.
  - Result: a dedicated invoice earns the partner the full commission rate on the net amount while the customer gets no discount.
- Referral reward: `maybeRewardReferral` (lib/actions-growth.ts:466-516) credits $5 (default `referralRewardCents`, lib/growth.ts:13) to BOTH the referrer and the referred user. It fires after the referred user's first paid action.
  - Callers: stripe.ts:1929, fulfil-checkout.ts:901, order.ts:1265.
  - A dedicated card leg triggers it through `creditCheckoutSession`. It does not reduce the dedicated price. It just adds wallet credit.
  - The wallet-only dedicated path does not call it.
- Admin and catalogue-side price reducers (these DO reach dedicated):
  - Setup policy "waived" or "custom" (lib/dedicated/pricing.ts:~136-146). "pass" passes through any live upstream OVH promo setup (`promoSetupCents`), e.g. free setup.
  - `overrideMonthlyCents` (hard price), negative markup (down to -100%, `clampPercent`), and `upliftPercent` (default 10, which raises prices).
  - Controls: `saveDedicatedItemControls` (lib/actions-dedicated.ts:99), admin pricing page app/admin/dedicated/pricing.
- Custom offers (`OfferKind.DEDICATED`, schema.prisma:8288): an admin sets the first-term price below renewal x term.
  - Math: `firstTermFromDiscount` and `termPromoPercentFor` (lib/offer-pricing.ts:134,139).
  - `fulfilOffer` (lib/offer-fulfil.ts:~300-460) debits the wallet, writes a PAID invoice, and creates an `OfferTask` "DEDICATED_BUILD". It does not create a `DedicatedServer` row (offer-link.ts says it is not merged).
  - This is a discount path, but it is admin-authored. It reaches a dedicated-kind invoice. It does not reach the IP order.
- Grandfathered price: `Server.grandfatheredRenewalCents`, with `adminSetGrandfatheredPrice` at lib/actions.ts:1332. `Server` only. The email `isGrandfathered` (lib/email-verification.ts:87) is unrelated.
- Retention offer: `claimRetentionOffer` (lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts:597), applied through `retentionDiscountCents` in renewal-charge.ts. `Server` only.
- Admin price edit: the admin form can set any `renewalMonthlyCents`, term and setup fee on a `DedicatedServer` (lib/actions-dedicated.ts:~205-215).

**2. Non-cash wallet credit (spendable on dedicated)**
- There is no cash/promo separation. The wallet is a single `User.balanceCents`. `WalletTransaction` has no kind column, only `amountCents` and a free-text `description` (schema.prisma:1289-1304).
- `User.signupCreditCents` (schema.prisma:223) is a one-shot marker of the amount granted. It is not a restricted balance and is never subtracted from spendable funds. Only kb-tools.ts reads it.
- `debitWallet` (lib/wallet.ts:~15) just checks `balanceCents >= cents`. `walletSplit` and `assertSpendCap` are generic. Dedicated paths use `debitWallet` and `walletSplit`.
- Sources of non-cash balance:
  - Signup "Welcome credit": `grantSignupCredit` at lib/actions.ts:~113-130, discord-auth.ts:37-45, and the Google callback at app/api/auth/google/callback/route.ts:~181-190. Setting `signup_free_credit_cents`, default 0.
  - Referral bonus: actions-growth.ts:503-516, descriptions "Referral bonus — welcome reward" and "Referral bonus — you referred a friend".
  - Riddle prize: `submitRiddleAnswer` (lib/riddle.ts:64-100), $100, `RIDDLE_PRIZE_DESC` = "…valid toward one VPS" (riddle.ts:17). That restriction is text only and is not enforced.
  - Gift codes: `redeemGiftCode` (lib/actions-gift.ts:108-131).
  - `CREDIT_CENTS` coupons: `redeemCreditCoupon` (lib/actions-gift.ts:157-207).
  - Top-up bonus: `topUp` demo gateway (lib/actions.ts:869-975). Dead in production because the real Stripe path adds no bonus.
  - Admin credit: `adminCreditUser` (lib/actions.ts:1745) and `adjustBalance` (lib/actions-admin-billing.ts:295).
  - Sandbox credit: lib/actions-sandbox.ts.
  - Partner grants: lib/partner-grants.ts (free game servers).
- Partial separation exists only for referral cash-out. `computeAffiliateEarnings` (lib/affiliate.ts:~85-120) caps cash-out at min(wallet, referral ledger sum), keyed on the description string `REFERRAL_EARNING_DESCRIPTION`. So referral credit spent on a dedicated server is simply gone from the cashable amount.
- Wallet refunds are also wallet credit: dedicated IP reject, failed domain, cancellation proration.

**3. Refund mechanisms**
- No Stripe `refunds.create` anywhere except lib/actions-admin-billing.ts:143. In `refundPayment` (:57-280):

- Four other things can reach it:
  - Wallet balance built from promo credit can pay for it. The wallet has no cash/promo separation.
  - Admin-controlled pricing (setup waiver, price override, negative markup, custom offers) can lower it.
  - A partner commission can accrue on it.
  - A referral reward can be triggered by its card leg.
- Refunds: only the extra-IP "Reject & refund" and the generic admin invoice refund can target dedicated money. There is no self-serve or automatic refund for a dedicated server.
- Disputes: only recorded and alerted, nothing automatic.
- Note: "dedicatedIp" elsewhere in the repo (lib/dedicated-ip.ts, lib/dedicated-ip-purchase.ts, `reconcileFailedDedicatedIp`) is the VPS dedicated-IPv4 add-on, not bare metal. Bare metal uses `DedicatedIpOrder` / `placeDedicatedIpOrder`.
